pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with predominantly smooth-to-softly angular edges. The spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the upper flank and mid-neck, becoming progressively smaller and more clustered towards the hindquarters and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Highly continuous topological graph of light-colored pelage. Junction nodes are clearly defined, primarily consisting of tri-modal intersections. Path thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-lateral surface, with high pixel continuity throughout the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D jagged silhouette along the superior neck and shoulder region, characterized by low-amplitude, high-frequency peaks of the mane against the background.
